description: The chart illustrates the effect of various morphosyntactic categories on multilingual BERT models, comparing the performance of different models across four categories: case, gender, number, and tense. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the effect, ranging from 0 to 20 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5. Each category is associated with a group of six bars, representing different models: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, colored in distinct shades of blue, green, and red, as indicated in the legend. The bars for the "case" category have the highest values, with mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2 reaching approximately 11 and 10, respectively, while the bars for "tense" have the lowest values, mostly below 1. The bars within each group are not stacked, and the models are consistently ordered across categories. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on particular bars.
